system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Acrobatics and Stealth, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Lore of a city, Local Routes Lore, Lore of a courier network.
system.description: You carried messages through crowded streets and across unfriendly borders. Getting there mattered; arriving unnoticed sometimes mattered more. One delivery may have changed the course of your life.
